app.name: Digital Procurement & Submissions
app.document_title: Digital Procurement & Submissions — Buq'ata Local Council

shell.trust_body: Tenders: automatic distribution that cannot be edited, and offers sealed until the deadline. Quotation requests: the list is generated automatically and may be edited with a recorded reason, and the opening mode is chosen when the request is created. Every action goes to a signed log.

auth.sign_in_hint: Suppliers and council staff sign in with their e-mail and password.
auth.staff_sso_note: In production, council staff sign in with their organisational Microsoft account (Entra ID) and multi-factor authentication.
auth.demo_hint: Pick a user to see the system from their point of view. This option does not exist in production.

landing.kicker: One platform for every council procurement and submission process
landing.title: From registration to protocol — transparent, secure and fair
landing.subtitle: Suppliers register once and automatically receive every opportunity in their field. Offers are sealed in a digital vault and opened together, under policy, with a full record.
landing.step1_title: Suppliers register and choose their fields
landing.step1_body: Business details, documents and categories — once.
landing.step2_body: The system finds every supplier registered in the field and sends to all of them. For quotation requests procurement may edit the list — every change is justified and recorded.
landing.step3_title: Offers are sealed in the vault
landing.step3_body: Each offer is encrypted and receives a submission receipt with a fingerprint.
landing.step4_body: All offers open together after the deadline; the decision is recorded and a protocol is produced.
landing.principle_efficiency: Less paper, fewer office visits and less manual work in every process.
landing.principle_transparency: Automatic distribution, a fairness report and a signed audit trail.
landing.principle_equal_opportunity: Every registered supplier in the field is included automatically; any deviation is justified and recorded.
landing.principle_security: Encryption, policy-based opening and integrity checks on every file.
landing.type_rfq_body: Automatic distribution to the field's suppliers with justified edits, and an opening mode chosen per request.
landing.type_tender_body: Digital vault, opening with multiple approvals from an approved network. (In development)
landing.type_scholarship_body: Applications, eligibility checks and a committee with conflict-of-interest declarations. (In development)
landing.supplier_question: Do you provide services to the council?

register.title: Join the supplier registry
register.subtitle: Register once and receive automatic invitations to every process in the categories you choose.
register.fairness_body: Every active supplier registered in the category is included in the distribution automatically. For quotation requests procurement may edit the list, and every change is justified and recorded; for tenders the list cannot be edited.
register.company_number_hint: Company or licensed dealer number — 8 or 9 digits
register.categories_hint: Choosing a parent category (e.g. 'IT & computing') covers all of its sub-categories. Only choose categories you actually serve.
register.terms: I confirm the details are correct and agree that the council will notify me about processes in the categories I chose.

categories.title: Business categories
categories.subtitle: The category tree drives supplier registration and automatic distribution. Changes here need no code changes.
categories.key_hint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and dots. Cannot be changed later.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.admin_scope: System administrators manage users, categories and configuration. They have no access to offer content — a deliberate separation of duties.
dashboard.participation_hint: Invited versus submitted. The number submitted is revealed only after opening.

processes.title: Processes
processes.subtitle: All council procurement and submission processes
processes.name: Process
processes.subtitle_own: Quotation requests you opened or were added to

new.title: New process
new.subtitle: Choose the process type. Each type loads its own workflow and rules.
new.subtitle_rfq: Choose a category — the system sends the request to every supplier registered in it.
new.desc_rfq: Automatic distribution to every supplier in the category, sealed offers, comparison and decision.
new.desc_tender: Digital vault, 3-of-5 opening approval, approved network and device.
new.desc_scholarship: Applications, eligibility checks, scoring and committee.
new.desc_call_for_proposals: Calls for proposals and grants — on the same foundation.
new.desc_support: Support requests for associations and organisations.
new.categories_hint: The request goes to every active supplier registered in these categories, their parents and their sub-categories.
new.matching_title: Registered suppliers who will receive it
new.matching_empty: Choose a category to see how many suppliers will receive the request.
new.list_read_only: View only — the list cannot be edited.
new.publish_confirm: The request will be frozen as a published version and sent now to {count} suppliers. It cannot be edited after publication.
new.editable_rule: The list is generated from the request categories. For a quotation request you may remove or add suppliers — a reason is required and the change is recorded in the audit trail and the fairness report.

rfq.title: Request title
rfq.attachments_hint: Specifications and appendices (PDF, Word, Excel). Shown to invited suppliers.
rfq.deadline_hint: Israel time. Submissions after this moment are refused by the server.

process.participants_hint: Only participants may access content after opening
process.publish_confirm: The version will be frozen and sent automatically to every supplier registered in the process categories. It cannot be edited after publication.
process.add_participant_hint: Add the procurement team so they can open the offers and decide.
process.no_candidates: No other staff can be added

fairness.not_published_body: The distribution list is fixed at the moment of publication.
fairness.banner_body: Every active supplier registered in the process categories was invited. No manual selection was made, and the list cannot be changed.
fairness.snapshots_hint: Each snapshot is sealed with a SHA-256 fingerprint. Suppliers who register after publication are added in a supplemental snapshot.
fairness.submitted_hidden: Who submitted is revealed only after the vault is opened.
fairness.banner_editable_body: The list was generated from every active supplier in the process categories. For quotation requests suppliers may be added or removed; every change appears here with its reason, who made it and when.
fairness.manual_changes_body: Added manually: {added} · Removed: {removed}. Details are in the table and the protocol.

opening.not_published: Not yet published — there is no vault yet.
opening.sealed_body: Offers are encrypted. Nobody — including system administrators — can see a price or a document before opening.
opening.opened_body: The vault was opened at {at}. All offers were opened together.
opening.policy_hint: Evaluated on the server, for you, right now
opening.confirm: All {count} offers will open together, every file's integrity will be verified, and every submitter will be notified. This cannot be undone.
opening.no_permission: You are not authorised to open this process.
opening.early_warning: An attempt to open before the opening time is refused and recorded as a security event.
opening.result_body: {count} offers opened · {files} files verified · integrity failures: {failures}
opening.visible_body: Offers in this request are not sealed: the process team sees them as they arrive (encrypted at rest, every view logged). No opening is needed — the comparison is in the Comparison & decision tab.
opening.early_allowed: This request may be opened before the deadline. Opening closes submissions for every supplier.
opening.early_confirm: This opening is before the deadline and will close submissions for suppliers who have not yet submitted.

policy_code.outside_allowed_network: Request is not from the council network
policy_code.not_a_participant: You are not assigned to this process

evaluation.sealed_body: The comparison table appears only after the vault is opened.
evaluation.no_access_body: Content is visible to process participants only, or with an explicit, reasoned grant from the owner.
evaluation.no_winner_title: The system does not choose a winner
evaluation.no_winner_body: The table shows the data as submitted. You can sort it, but the decision rests with authorised council officials.
evaluation.reason_hint: Stored in the protocol and the audit trail (at least 10 characters).
evaluation.decision_note: The decision is recorded in your name, with time and reason, and every submitter is told a decision was made.
evaluation.live_note: Submissions are still open: more offers may arrive. Recording a decision now closes submissions.

protocols.hint: The protocol includes distribution, opening, comparison, decision and the audit chain head. Its fingerprint is stored in the audit trail.
protocols.not_yet: A protocol can be generated after the vault is opened.

supplier_home.title: My opportunities
supplier_home.subtitle: Processes sent to you automatically based on the categories you chose.
supplier_home.welcome_body: From now on you will automatically receive every request in your categories. You can update categories and documents in your company profile.
supplier_home.empty_body: When the council publishes a process in your field, it will appear here and you will be notified.

submit.title: Submit an offer
submit.subtitle: Prices and files are encrypted the moment you submit.
submit.price_hint: VAT and total are calculated automatically
submit.seal_note_body: Nobody at the council — including system administrators — can see your offer until the joint opening after the deadline.
submit.confirm: Submit an offer of {total} including VAT? Until the deadline you can submit a new version that replaces this one.
submit.receipt_hint: Keep this receipt. The fingerprints prove what was submitted and when.
submit.sealed_body: It will be opened only after the deadline, together with all other offers, and you will be notified.
submit.replace_hint: Until the deadline you may submit an updated version. Only the latest version is opened.
submit.opened_body: Offers were opened together after the deadline. You will be notified when a decision is recorded.
submit.fair_body: The invitation was sent based on the categories you registered in. Every registered supplier in the category is included automatically, and every change to the list is recorded.
submit.visible_body: In this request offers are visible to the process's procurement team from the moment of submission. Until the deadline you may submit an updated version.
submit.seal_note_anytime: Your offer is encrypted until the joint opening. In this request the council may open all offers before the deadline.
submit.visible_note_title: Your offer will be visible to procurement
submit.visible_note_body: Offers in this request are not sealed: the process's procurement team will see your offer as soon as you submit it. It is stored encrypted and every view is logged.

profile.title: Company profile
profile.subtitle: Your details, categories and certificates in the supplier registry.
profile.categories_saved_invites: Categories updated — {count} invitations to open processes were added
profile.number_locked: The company number cannot be changed after registration
profile.categories_hint: Changing categories also invites you automatically to matching open processes
profile.certificates_hint: Shown to the committee next to every offer, with validity

registry.title: Supplier registry
registry.subtitle: Suppliers register themselves or are added by the administrator, and choose their categories. Distribution to processes derives from these categories only.
registry.search: Search by name, number or town…
registry.archive_hint: Archiving removes the supplier from the registry and from future distributions and blocks their sign-in. The history is kept and the supplier can be restored.
registry.password_hint: Initial password (at least 10 characters) — hand it to the supplier.
registry.email_fixed: The e-mail is used to sign in and cannot be changed here.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Every important action is written as a signed, chained record. Changing an earlier record is detected by chain verification.
audit.valid: The chain is intact — {count} events checked
audit.events_hint: Click a row for details and fingerprints
audit.verify_only: Your role may verify the chain's integrity only, without viewing event content.

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Council staff, roles and separation of duties.
users.sod_body: You cannot grant a role to yourself. Every business-role grant is logged and reported to oversight. System administrators get no access to offers.
users.name: Name
users.business_alert: This is a business role — oversight will be alerted about the grant.
users.password_hint: Leave empty for users who sign in through Entra ID

invite.body: You received this invitation for a council process. Sign in to view the request and submit an offer.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is not valid

errors.http_500: Server error. Please try again shortly.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.forbidden: You are not permitted to do this
errors.csrf_failed: The form expired. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.not_found: Not found, or you have no access
errors.company_number_taken: This company number is already registered
errors.not_accepting_submissions: This process is not accepting submissions
errors.not_invited: Your company is not in this process's distribution
errors.file_content_mismatch: The file content does not match its type
errors.file_rejected_by_scanner: The file was blocked by the security scan
errors.opening_policy_failed: The opening policy is not satisfied
errors.not_a_participant: You are not assigned to this process
errors.invalid_transition: This action is not possible at the current stage
errors.file_integrity_failure: The file failed integrity verification and is blocked
errors.self_grant_forbidden: You cannot grant a role to yourself
errors.opening_already_requested: An opening request is already pending
errors.process_type_unavailable: This process type is not available yet
errors.opening_before_deadline: Opening time is before the deadline
errors.invalid_submission: The selected offer is not valid
errors.self_change_forbidden: You cannot change your own account
errors.distribution_not_editable: The distribution list of this process type cannot be edited
errors.distribution_closed: The list can be edited only while submissions are open
errors.already_invited: The supplier is already on the distribution list
errors.supplier_already_submitted: The supplier has already submitted and cannot be removed
errors.not_sealed: Offers in this request are not sealed — there is nothing to open
errors.already_participant: This person already takes part in the process in this capacity

opening_mode.title: How offers are opened
opening_mode.subtitle: Set when the request is created; can change until publication.
opening_mode.visible_hint: The process team sees each offer as it is submitted. A decision may be made before the deadline.
opening_mode.sealed_anytime_hint: Offers are encrypted until opened. Opening before the deadline is allowed — it closes submissions.
opening_mode.sealed_after_deadline_hint: Offers open only after the deadline, all together — as in a tender.

distribution_edit.add_title: Add a supplier to the distribution
distribution_edit.reason_hint: Required (at least 5 characters). Kept in the audit trail, the fairness report and the protocol.
distribution_edit.remove_note: The supplier will no longer be able to view the request or submit. A supplier who has already submitted cannot be removed.
